scope: Automatic foreground capture stale-band/default-channel fix; preserve AP/bridge implementation, capture engine switches, takeover/restore and UI layout.
reproduction: Two offline card refresh tests failed before the change: 2.4G->5G and 5G->2.4G left the old default channel text unchanged. Both pass after the change.
root_causes: The card refresh and page refresh replaced radio_info without updating the default channel list.
Non-empty user channel lists bypassed hardware/band validation.
changes: One pure shared channel policy based on physical frequency rows and disabled flags, not radio/phy numbering or iw Band heading indices.
Untouched defaults resolve in the existing worker using live capabilities. User edits, including deliberate empty input, remain intact.
Read iw phy info once after verified radio-to-phy resolution and before takeover, stale sweep or monitor creation; reject invalid/mismatched/unavailable channels.
For physical multi-band devices use the freshly read configured band; ambiguity or a disabled selected band stops startup.
Existing sessions adopt new device information only after active worker, recovery and leftover-placeholder gates pass.
No additional timer, no UI-thread remote IO, no wireless driver replacement, no new changes to AP/bridge execution.

excerpt: "                  important notice: channel numbers are not unique\n"

compatibility.command: iw phy <verified phy> info; existing POSIX command and shared iter_phy_channels parser reused
compatibility.hardware_policy: Frequency/capability driven and architecture independent. Both numbering permutations, 2.4G/5G/6G and multi-band inputs tested; not a per-model live compatibility claim.
compatibility.legacy_tools: Existing legacy numerical channel conversion and engine options retained.
compatibility.system_range: Same public policy for supported official 19.07/21.02/22.03/23.05/24.10/25.12 series; missing or unparseable capabilities explicitly block startup. Exact per-device live acceptance remains required.

verification.visual: Offscreen widgets rendered in both themes; layout size, stylesheet and hidden channel-row visibility unchanged.

live_acceptance: On Mini, radio0 first attempt must receive 5G channels and radio1 first attempt must receive 2.4G channels.
Repeat single and dual starts, refresh and reconnect; correct first attempt must not depend on a wrong-band fallback.
Verify existing 3G/other known-good devices without changing driver or engine options.
A manually entered wrong-band list must be rejected before takeover or monitor creation.
